overview.en:
Read spreadsheets and update values, formulas and structure through Google’s official Workspace MCP service.

Inspect spreadsheet structure and values before changing cells or formulas. Make ranges and assumptions explicit, and describe how the result can be checked.

This connection requires Google Workspace Developer Preview access, a configured Google Cloud project, and your own OAuth application. Complete that setup in Ghast before requesting account data or edits.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Google 官方 Workspace MCP 服务读取表格并更新数据、公式与结构。

修改单元格或公式前先检查表格结构与数据，明确范围和假设，并说明如何核对结果。

此连接需要 Google Workspace Developer Preview 访问权限、已配置的 Google Cloud 项目和自有 OAuth 应用。请先在 Ghast 中完成配置，再请求账号数据或编辑操作。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this sheet and identify the key metrics and data gaps.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 总结这张表，识别关键指标与数据缺口。

starterPrompts.en: Review these formulas and explain any errors or inconsistent references.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 检查这些公式，解释错误或不一致的引用。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare an update to this table with the requested calculations.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这张表准备包含所需计算的数据更新。

descriptions.en: Use Google Sheets in Ghast. Read spreadsheets and update values, formulas and structure through Google’s official Workspace MCP service. 通过 Google 官方 Workspace MCP 服务读取表格并更新数据、公式与结构。
